pages.title: Astral Compass
pages.text: Forge a $(item)Magic Shard$(0) into an ordinary $(item)Compass$(0), and its needle will sense the aura of the $(thing)Astral Plague$(0). No longer pointing to your spawn, it now always aims at the nearest $(thing)Astral Lands$(0). $(br)The needle shimmers like an enchanted trinket; if no plague zone can be sensed nearby (nearby zones must already be explored and loaded), it loses its target and spins wildly.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: Combine a $(item)Compass$(0) and a $(item)Magic Shard$(0) in any arrangement in a $(item)Crafting Table$(0) to transform it into an $(item)Astral Compass$(0). $(br)The plague still spreads — may this needle guide you to the traces of the divine beasts, rather than to your doom in the Astral Lands.
